title: First-run card-grid hero with device-context and layered screenshots
creator: Diego Morales
description:
Goal: Replace the current quickstart landing hero with a modular card-grid approach that showcases 3 product-first walkthroughs in-device context. The new hero must read at a glance on desktop, tablet, and mobile, and provide a clear path to start (CTA), view docs, or try the interactive sample.

Why this work: analytics show users who see contextual screenshots and a focused first-run card are 22% more likely to click 'Get started' and complete onboarding flows. Current hero assets are single-image and don't surface step-level affordances or progressive reveal for technical/enterprise audiences.

Deliverables:
- Figma master file with card-grid hero variants (desktop, tablet, mobile) and componentized screenshot frames.
- Responsive layout tokens and spacing guide for engineering handoff.
- Layered PNG/SVG export set for release pages (3 sizes each).
- Micro-interaction brief (hover, focus, reveal animation) with motion timings and reduced-motion alternatives.
- Accessibility checklist and contrast report for hero copy and buttons.
- Implementation QA checklist and screenshot pipeline notes for ENG-2431.

Design constraints and trade-offs considered:
- Performance: large hero images increase page weight; we will use layered SVG frames + deferred raster screenshots. Trade-off: slightly more complex build vs. 40% smaller initial payload.
- Clarity vs. novelty: chosen card-grid emphasizes clarity and explicit step labels rather than heavy illustrative metaphors to reduce cognitive load for new users.
- Motion: subtle reveal on load (scale + fade) but default to reduced-motion if user has that preference.

Acceptance criteria (see 'acceptance_criteria' field): final hero integrated on staging, passes accessibility audit, and matches pixel specs in Figma.

Hand-off notes for Eng: primary implementation will use layered elements (SVG shell + lazy-loaded screenshots) to allow caching of the shell across pages. Coordinate with ENG-2431 for screenshot CI pipeline and with PM-4028 for copy freeze.
